title: desmodium triquetrum var. pseudotriquetrum
intro: Desmodium triquetrum var. pseudotriquetrum, commonly known as False Goat's Rue, is a plant species within the legume family (Fabaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation, acting as a diuretic, and providing antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of this plant include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antispasmodic properties, which contribute to its use in treating conditions like fever, rheumatism, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents present in Desmodium triquetrum var. pseudotriquetrum include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and health benefits.
